authority: Plan 12.13 v3 (sha256 26653bbc2123e66d990d37977f9ab81a6ded9121de7594e358b0c9fdad31ffa0), sections /why, #242, #245, Evaluation and releases; D2-D4 approved by the operator 2026-11-23

inputs.binding: every result names the sha256 of each input file and the git commit it ran at; a changed input invalidates earlier results

cost.rule: local stand-ins only; any paid egress invalidates the run

split_custody.train: calibration and debugging; may be inspected freely
split_custody.held_out: consumed once, in Task 3 qualification, after CP1 froze the partition and ranking features; no tuning against its results; a second use needs a recorded successor disposition

ambiguity_242.ranked_list: every eligible candidate, ordered by ranking-policy.json; the baseline list is the same set in path_only order

metrics.top_one_accuracy: share of decidable cases whose first suggestion is in the acceptable set
metrics.reciprocal_rank: mean over decidable cases of 1 / rank of the best-ranked acceptable target
metrics.wrong_target_selections: count of cases where the system read or edited a file outside the acceptable set without an exact path naming it
metrics.oracle_regret: mean agent-selected loss over decidable cases

agent_selected_loss.note: the loss scores what the system actually acted on; under D3 a multi-candidate case is a visible stop, so it scores 0.25 when decidable and 0 when not

ambiguity_242.denominators: report decidable and undecidable counts separately, per split; undecidable cases enter only wrong_target_selections and abstention checks
ambiguity_242.not_confidence: a rank or score is never reported as a probability or confidence
acceptance: zero wrong-target selections on every split
every multi-candidate case stops visibly; no eligible candidate is lost; denied files never appear
held-out: ranked top_one_accuracy and reciprocal_rank both at least the path_only baseline, and at least one of them strictly higher
without held-out benefit there is no #242 completion claim

split_245.accounting: UTF-8 bytes of the real serializers (_serialize_planning_observation, _serialize_planning_read_evidence), including headers, paths, hashes and framing; bytes and tokens reported separately (tokens by the existing estimator)
split_245.simulation: each schedule is driven through the real planning-loop parse, read and pack code with only the two limits substituted; synthetic workspace files carry the ranges; a placeholder or real 64-hex sha256 as the schedule states
split_245.completed: the schedule reaches FINAL_PLAN within max_planning_turns with every requested range delivered whole and no budget stop (OBSERVATION_TOO_LARGE, PLANNING_OBSERVATION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, PLANNING_READ_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED), and the final request passes the existing route fitting (ContextPacker.fit) unchanged
split_245.never_completion: truncated or dropped required evidence; a typed refusal or guarded reread counts as a stop, recorded with its code
selection_on_train_and_development: 1. reject any partition whose run weakens source-hash, completeness, ambiguity or route-fit checks
2. require no loss on baseline-success schedules
3. maximize completed schedules; ties prefer fewer budget stops, then the partition closest to 4/12
4. at qualification, require at least one held-out completion improvement over 4/12 and no held-out baseline-success regression
split_245.no_qualifier: if no non-baseline partition passes 1-3 at CP1, 4/12 is kept, the plan stops for operator disposition, and #245 delivery is not claimed
split_245.recorded_at_cp1: the chosen numeric limits, before any production change

why.oracle: the snapshot fields equal the facts the turn actually produced (manifest, served set, dispatch records); never recomputed by rerunning retrieval or rereading memory
why.privacy: no privacy sentinel, generated token, body, signature, description, prompt, memory statement or hidden reasoning in any page; checked on raw ACP output bytes
why.calls: zero classification, maintenance, extraction, embedding or provider calls for every /why, counted at the real seams
why.states: missing fields say unavailable; prepared is never shown as dispatched; a failed read is never 'no memory'; historical metadata is never presented as current validity
why.paging: cases.json explanation.page_bounds; every entry appears on exactly one page

determinism: repeated and reordered inputs give byte-identical rankings, schedule outcomes and /why pages
boundary_claims: real index Redis, real store, acpx, Zed and WSL claims need their own released runs (cases.json release_configuration); fakes prove unit behavior only; a missing release holds the claim as UNRUN
results_retained: losses, unknowns, skips, invalid cases and consumed held-out sets are kept; COMPLETE alone is not acceptance
